topic: King Fahd Causeway Saudi Arabia to Bahrain
hook: Your car can drive from Saudi Arabia to Bahrain.
title: You Can Drive Across the Sea to Bahrain
description:
The King Fahd Causeway links Saudi Arabia and the island nation of Bahrain across the Gulf. It runs about 25 kilometres and opened in 1986. An artificial island partway along holds the border facilities. Part of the series Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Bahrain #Geography
